# Media demo

---

## Images

## Markdown image syntax

![A logo](logo.png)

## Wikilink embed

![[logo.png]]

## Display control

![[logo.png|contain center]]

## Float, size and caption together

![[logo.png|align-right|A floating caption]]

![[logo.png|align-left 40%|Another one]]

---

## Media demo

moss resolves images, video, and other static assets automatically.

See [[images]] for image embedding examples.
